limitations: Pins are pending the final build; the gold is not valid for a run until Hassan's build, allowlist and exclusion hashes are recorded.
Five cases (d, f, h, i, m) need release notes; the current 18-source index has none.
Passage observation is necessary, not sufficient: support, version scope and usefulness remain human judgments after a run.
Alternatives are capped at 10 per requirement; an equivalent passage outside the listed versions is reported as not observed and needs manual review.
All 16 final hashes differ from the reviewed hashes only by the evidence_condition label fix; cases p and e also carry the reviewed passage amendments.
